servingRegression.symptom: The first deterministic certificate attempt panicked while conditioning a reachable rare public line with total reach below the generic game epsilon.
servingRegression.cause: Range normalization treated positive reach at or below 1e-12 as impossible even though conditioning is scale invariant.
servingRegression.fix: Reject only non-finite or genuinely non-positive reach; retain fail-closed rejection for exactly zero reach.
